facts.fact: The electoral commission CENI president Prosper Ntahorwamiye announced on 15 October 2024 that anyone enrolling as a voter in the 22-31 October 2024 enrolment must present a valid national identity card.

BDI.note: No count or share of people holding an ID given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs or owns the ID system.
Voters present the ID card at enrolment; no register is said to be keyed on the ID number.
National ID cards are mentioned only as a requirement and for their old territorial boundaries; issuing, biometrics and certification not stated.
Nothing on local government office connection.
